items.title: Bill Bourgeois Interview, 1959-12-10
items.q: Oh, I know Hank for quite a while. We worked together in New York.

ctx.x: Yeah, I see. Sort of took after him. Yeah. And while we were talking, you mentioned Hank Kamen, one of the teachers here. You used to know him.

Oh, I know Hank for quite a while. We worked together in New York. What was that about Hitler's birthday? Oh, we played a birthday party, Hitler's birthday party at the Liederkranz Hall, which is the German hall there. And our leader of the band was a Jew. And if they had known that they'd have thrown him right out of the place. Who was it? Lou Lockett. Of course that wasn't his right name. They thought he was a German or something, huh? Yeah, Lockett, you know, any other, anything else but a Jew.
